name: Focus Minerals Limited
summary: Focus Minerals Limited engages in the exploration and development of gold properties in Western Australia. The company owns 100% interest in the Coolgardie Gold Project located in the East of Perth, Western Australia. It also operates Three Mile Hill Processing plant; and open pit and underground deposits. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in East Perth, Australia. Focus Minerals Limited operates as a subsidiary of Shandong Gold International Mining Corporation Limited.
